synthesis.fm_bass: f_inst=f_c + f_c*I(t)*sin(2*pi*f_m*t); I(t)=I0*exp(-1.5t); add sub oscillator
synthesis.normalization: peak-normalize each one-shot to 0.88; 3ms linear attack; measured RMS/peak in preset metadata
